This issue might be a duplicate of existing issues. Please check:
- #17169: Subagent enters infinite retry loop on edit/write tool failure — same core behavior of the model repeatedly retrying a failed edit call without stopping
- #21034: gemma-4-26b and gemma-4-31b opencode interaction issues leading to tool loops/failures — same model family (gemma-4) exhibiting tool call loops/failures in OpenCode
- #19040: Edit/write tools enter infinite retry loops when external processes modify files — related infinite retry loop on edit tool failure (different trigger, same loop behavior)

Please review these issues to see if your report is already covered, and consider adding your findings there if so.
